page.layout: One blank yellow page, a plain cover-like sheet photographed on a grey background; no printed text, no columns, no margins with text.
page.notes: The scan shows only a blank yellowed leaf (apparently a cover or endpaper) with no printed words, headings, page numbers, running heads, catchwords or signatures. Nothing has been transcribed. The dark grey surround and the blue-grey board edge on the right are the scanning background and binding, not printed matter.
